## Code Elements

### React Components

#### `App`
- **Location**: `frontend/src/App.tsx`
- **Type**: Functional Component
- **Description**: Root component that wraps the entire app in `<AuthProvider>` and delegates routing to `<RouterProvider router={router} />`. Does not render any UI directly.
- **Exports**: Default export; named as `App`
- **Props**: None
- **Children**: `<AuthProvider>` → `<RouterProvider>` → route-matched page component
- **Side Effects**: None (pure shell)

#### `router`
- **Location**: `frontend/src/router.tsx`
- **Type**: `BrowserRouter` config (react-router-dom `createBrowserRouter`)
- **Description**: Defines all client-side routes. Protected routes are wrapped in `<ProtectedRoute>` which redirects unauthenticated users to `/login`.
- **Routes**:
  | Path | Component | Auth Required |
  |------|-----------|---------------|
  | `/` | `HomePage` → `Dashboard` | ✅ Yes |
  | `/login` | `LoginPage` | ❌ No |
  | `/mfa` | `MfaPage` | ❌ No |
  | `/protected` | `ProtectedPage` | ✅ Yes |
  | `/playwright` | `PlaywrightPage` | ✅ Yes |

### Entry Point Functions

#### `createRoot().render()`
- **Location**: `frontend/src/main.tsx:6–10`
- **Type**: React 18 DOM API call
- **Description**: Application bootstrap using React 18 createRoot API. Renders App component into DOM element with ID `root`.
- **Flow**: 
  1. Finds DOM node: `document.getElementById('root')`
  2. Creates React root with `createRoot()`
  3. Renders `<StrictMode><App /></StrictMode>`
- **Strict Mode**: Enabled for development warnings and double-invoke behavior in development

## Component Tree
```
<StrictMode>
  └── <App>
      └── <AuthProvider>            (JWT auth context)
          └── <RouterProvider>
              ├── /           → <ProtectedRoute> → <HomePage> → <Dashboard>
              ├── /login      → <LoginPage>
              ├── /mfa        → <MfaPage>
              ├── /protected  → <ProtectedRoute> → <ProtectedPage>
              └── /playwright → <ProtectedRoute> → <PlaywrightPage>
```

## Data Flow
- Auth state (JWT tokens, user, logout) provided by `AuthProvider` via React Context
- Routing handled by react-router-dom; route-level auth guard in `ProtectedRoute`
- No global state management (Redux/Zustand) — state is lifted to `Dashboard` and below

## Notes for Higher-Level Synthesis
- **App entry point** — belongs in Frontend Container documentation as the client-side bootstrap
- **Minimal logic** — App.tsx is a pure shell; all execution logic lives in `Dashboard` and below
- **React 19 setup** — Uses modern createRoot API (not ReactDOM.render)
- **StrictMode enabled** — Development-only; double-invokes effects in dev for early detection of side-effect bugs
- **Auth-first design** — `AuthProvider` wraps the router so auth state is available to all routes, including the router itself
